title: podolepis aristata subsp. auriculata
intro: Podolepis aristata subsp. auriculata, commonly known as Golden Bells, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the relief of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Golden Bells include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
